correctness.rationale: The exchangeable binary triple distribution is determined by count masses (1−3p+3q−r,3(p−2q+r),3(q−r),r). Their nonnegativity gives exactly max(0,2q−p)≤r≤min(q,1−3p+3q), and uniform labeled assignments at each count construct every feasible r. Complete mixing gives X_{t+1}=g_K X_t and the iid log law implies almost-sure exponent E log g_K. Differentiating in r gives δ=log(h(h+2l)^3/[l(2h+l)^3])>0 since h(h+2l)^3−l(2h+l)^3=(h−l)^3(h+l)>0. At p=1/2,q=1/4,l=1/30,h=10/3, exact endpoint products g0 g2³=300763/810000<1 and g1³g3=9826/2025>1 show opposite exponential signs with pairwise-independent site environments. Two binary sites have fixed full joint law once marginals and pair success probabilities are set. Independently replayed rational mass constraints, identity and exact witness.
